description: This file defines a Java interface named DataRegistrationBroker, which extends another interface StatusChangeListener. It declares methods related to registering, deregistering, and clearing logger data within an ECU logging UI context.

classes.name: DataRegistrationBroker
classes.description: A Java interface for managing registration of LoggerData objects for logging, extending status change listening capabilities.

methods.name: registerLoggerDataForLogging
methods.description: Registers a LoggerData object for logging.

methods.name: deregisterLoggerDataFromLogging
methods.description: Deregisters a LoggerData object from logging.
